questions.text: How does the secondary mortgage market (operated by NHMFC) enable continuous housing loan availability?

options.text: It limits the number of loans primary lenders can issue, ensuring that only the most qualified applicants receive funding, thereby maintaining a stable financial environment
It guarantees that all housing loans will be paid without default, providing a safety net for lenders and encouraging them to issue more loans
It purchases loans from primary lenders (Pag-IBIG, banks), replenishing their capital so they can originate new loans
It replaces primary lenders entirely and becomes the sole source of housing finance, centralizing the loan process under one entity

questions.rationale: NHMFC buys loans from primary lenders, converting those loans into investment instruments. This returns capital to the lender, enabling them to issue new loans rather than waiting for repayment. This recycling mechanism is essential for loan availability. questions.text: What is the primary purpose of NHMFC (National Home Mortgage Finance Corporation) in the housing finance system?

options.text: To originate new housing loans to individual borrowers, focusing on first-time homebuyers and low-income families
To regulate housing loan terms and interest rates, ensuring they remain competitive and accessible to the general public
To insure housing loans against borrower default, providing a safety net for lenders in case of financial instability
To purchase housing loans from primary lenders, returning capital so lenders can issue new loans (secondary mortgage market function)
